text: Questions one to five. The campus library is opening a quiet study room on Monday. It is on the second floor, beside the history collection. Students must book a desk online. Each booking lasts two hours. Please leave food outside the room. Water in a closed bottle is welcome.
questions: When will the quiet room open?
How should students book a desk?
How long does each booking last?

text: Questions six to ten. A student cycling club will meet at the north gate this Saturday at nine in the morning. The route is twelve kilometres long. Members should bring a helmet. The club will lend lights to anyone who needs them. If heavy rain is forecast, the ride will move to Sunday.

Questions eleven to fifteen. The community garden needs volunteers on Wednesday afternoon. Work begins at two and ends at four. New volunteers will learn to plant beans. Tools are provided, but everyone should wear strong shoes. The vegetables grown here are shared with a nearby community kitchen.
questions: When does the garden need help?
录音明确说 begins at two。
Who receives some of the vegetables?
蔬菜与附近的社区厨房分享。

text: Questions sixteen to twenty. A small museum is offering a free workshop on repairing household objects. It takes place on the first Sunday of each month. Participants can bring one broken item. An experienced engineer will guide them. Booking closes three days before the workshop. Children under twelve must come with an adult.
questions: How much does the workshop cost?
How often is the workshop held?
How many broken items may each person bring?
由有经验的工程师指导。
预约在活动前三天截止。

text: Questions twenty-one to twenty-five. A research team studied how students use short breaks. Sixty students took part for four weeks. Half walked outdoors during their breaks; the others stayed at their desks. The walking group reported feeling more alert. The researchers did not measure exam scores, so they cannot say that walking improved grades.
questions: How long did the study last?
What did half of the students do during breaks?
How did the walking group report feeling?
What did the researchers NOT measure?
研究未测量考试分数，不能推出提高成绩。
